_readme: S639 harvest side session, 2026-11-12. Berkeley City College, fourth read. The third (berkeley_city_ge_tabs, run 43139721172) listed the tabs: under Degree and Certificate Requirements (list 41810), 41811 'Associate Degree Requirements' and 41812 'Certificate Requirements'; under Transfer Information (list 41800), 41802 'California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)' and 41805 'Associate Degrees for Transfer (ADT)' among nine. Opening a tab list as an entry printed nothing (as at Butte), so this read opens each tab as an entry of its list (cq_view) and prints each tab's own page (_getPage) besides. Asked: Cal-GETC's areas, units and any total; the local A.A./A.S. general education pattern's units; any minimum-60, electives or double-count sentence. No model call.

questions.ge_units: What do Berkeley City's Associate Degree Requirements, Cal-GETC and ADT tabs print: areas, each area's units, a total, and any minimum-60, electives or double-count sentence?
